name: Dai Yunjie
current_role: Co-founder and Executive Director/President of XD Inc. (心动, HKEX: 2400); described as CEO of TapTap at TDW 2024
profile: Dai Yunjie (Kros Dai) co-founded P2P sharing site VeryCD with Huang Yimeng (Dash Huang) in 2003, then pivoted with him in 2010-11 into games, founding XD (Xindong). XD publishes and develops games and runs the TapTap game platform; Dai oversees daily operations, overseas business and product development.
interesting_fact: VeryCD, which Dai co-founded in 2003 and where he ran tech R&D and operations, ranked among the world's top 100 websites by traffic at its peak before pivoting in 2010 to found XD.
deep_cut_fact: At TapTap's TDW 2024 developer conference he said TapTap keeps ads to about 20% of homepage game exposure and that ~70% of the Android homepage is driven by user preferences; TapTap charges zero commission on mini-games.
notes: English name Kros Dai. Contact is company investor-relations site only; no published personal/press email found.

name: Adam Clammer
current_role: Chairman of the Board, Cellebrite DI Ltd. (since Jan 2025); Founding Partner, True Wind Capital Management
profile: Adam H. Clammer is a technology private-equity investor. He joined KKR in 1995 and co-founded and led its Global Technology Group (2004-2013), then founded San Francisco-based True Wind Capital in 2015. True Wind's SPAC TWC Tech Holdings II merged with forensics firm Cellebrite in 2021; he has chaired Cellebrite's board since January 2025.
interesting_fact: At KKR his board seats included Avago Technologies, Eastman Kodak, Jazz Pharmaceuticals, Medcath and NXP; he launched True Wind nearly two years after stepping down as KKR's head of technology investing.
deep_cut_fact: Before KKR he worked in Morgan Stanley's M&A group in New York and Hong Kong (1992-1995); he holds a B.S. from UC Berkeley and an MBA from Harvard Business School, where he was a Baker Scholar. He also chairs LeadVenture.
notes: Best route is likely via True Wind Capital or Cellebrite IR. No personal channels verified.

name: Lin Xiaofa
current_role: Party Secretary and Chairman, Jomoo Group (九牧集团); member of 14th CPPCC National Committee
profile: Lin Xiaofa (b. 1973, Fujian) is co-founder and chairman of Jomoo, a Xiamen-headquartered kitchen and bathroom fixtures maker founded in 1990 that grew from a family workshop into one of Asia's largest sanitary-ware bases, selling in 120+ countries. He is pushing global expansion and smart manufacturing.
interesting_fact: In 2009, when Jomoo's annual sales had just passed 2 billion yuan, he set the goal of a '10-billion-yuan, 100-year Jomoo'; in 2023 he said Jomoo should become the sanitary-ware industry's first brand with a 100-billion-yuan market value.
deep_cut_fact: He started out making dust-suppression spray systems for coal-cutting machines before applying spray tech to bathrooms; after a 1995 trip to Europe he led the team that made China's first handheld shower (花洒), and earlier China's first quick-open faucet.
notes: Company site jomoo.com; no published press/IR email found (Jomoo is private). Also held roles as Fujian Federation of Industry & Commerce vice chairman; named a National Model Worker.

name: Zhai Jun
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Vanjee Technology (北京万集科技, SZSE: 300552)
profile: Zhai Jun (b. 1963) founded Beijing Wanji (now Vanjee Technology) in 1994 and has been its chairman and general manager since. The Shenzhen-listed (2016) company supplies road and urban transport customers with weigh-in-motion, DSRC (ETC) short-range communications and laser-detection products; he is its controlling shareholder.
interesting_fact: Vanjee, which Zhai founded in 1994, listed on the Shenzhen ChiNext board in October 2016 and its products span dynamic vehicle weighing, dedicated short-range communication for highway tolling and laser detection.
deep_cut_fact: Zhai holds an MBA and the rank of professor-level senior engineer (正高级工程师); he is in the Ministry of Science and Technology's national expert pool and was selected for the national 'Ten Thousand Talents' programme as a tech innovation-entrepreneurship talent.
notes: IR email is the securities/board-secretary office (board secretary Yuan Zhiwei). Company co-founded with Fan Chunyang per registration records.
